items.headline: Sesko on track to return from shin injury before 2026-27 season
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko is following his recovery plan and has a chance of playing in the Atletico Madrid friendly on August 1.

items.headline: Manchester United beat Rosenborg 5-0 in pre-season friendly
items.summary: Shea Lacey scored opening goal as United dominated in Norway. Joshua Zirkzee also netted in comfortable victory.

items.headline: Zirkzee's Rosenborg performance insufficient to save his United career
items.summary: Joshua Zirkzee scored but his struggles suggest his Old Trafford spell is likely to end this summer.

items.headline: Juventus closing in on Joshua Zirkzee loan agreement
items.summary: The Dutchman appears set to leave United this summer with Italian club pursuing temporary deal.

items.headline: Carrick names youngsters as untouchable amid summer transfer activity
items.summary: Manager designates young prospects as key to club's future despite ongoing recruitment.
